input: Did the ledger record the decision to move payment reminders to three days after the due date?
Was SMS kept as an option the call considered and turned down?
Was the invoice CSV export for Northwind extracted as an action item?
Was the reminder change extracted as an action item?
Was 'do we charge late fees' kept as an open question rather than turned into work?
Was the spoken deadline 'next Friday' captured as the timing hint on the reminder work?
Was the escalation language on the blocked export captured verbatim, as the priority gate requires?
Was the reminder work assigned to the person who volunteered for it?
Was the export assigned to the person the call named?
Did the agent recognise the overdue dashboard as work that already has a ticket?
Did the agent notice that the code sends reminders at 7 days while the spec says 5?
Did the agent notice that the export spec includes payments while the code writes invoice columns only?
Does every quote that survived the evidence gate appear verbatim in the transcript?
Does every decision in the ledger carry the moment in the call that produced it?
Sam was named in the call but is not on this project. Was anything assigned to them?
Did anything leave the project's priority band without someone having said it was urgent?
Does every due date the agent set correspond to words somebody actually spoke?
Can every filed issue be audited from the tracker alone, without opening this system?
Where two sources disagree, did the agent report both sides with citations instead of picking a winner?
Is every scheduled check due after whatever it depends on?
Is every scheduled check in the future and inside the project's planning horizon?
A plan that schedules a check against an issue that does not exist: is it refused?
A plan whose tasks depend on each other in a cycle: is the whole plan refused?
Does every claim in the delivered status report carry at least one reference?
Does every tracker and ledger reference in the report point at something that exists?
Across every issue body, citation, plan parameter and report reference: did the agent ever invent an identifier?
Somebody called the blocked export urgent. Did the ticket come out of the pipeline urgent, or did the agent quietly file it as ordinary work?
